source_policy: Bounded public REST for personal noncommercial research, no credentials or paid service. Exact prior archive unavailable: independently hash/qualify newly acquired sources; never label them restored originals without matching hashes.
market-selector: Subset of frozen V4-ranked opportunities. Continuation: 1h confirmed structure aligned, completed 4h map ready, 4h direction not explicitly opposed, price <=2.5 signal ATR from previous completed VWAP, nearest known objective <=6 ATR and after-cost RR>=1.25. Reversal: preserve V4 independent setup with same first-objective economic check. Same entry, stop, target, native lifecycle.
ema-context: Same raw continuation predicates and V4 rank formula except remove the three EMA alignment/slope predicates and 1h EMA shortlist veto; require aligned confirmed 1h structure. Other V4 structure, volume, location, stop/target and liquidity rules retained. This changes eligibility, not only annotations.
entry-passive: Same selected V4 opportunities; completed trigger then reference moves 0.15 signal ATR toward defended location, same stop/target, expiry 5 minutes; no chase. Native legal price and risk checks remain.
thesis-exit: Same V4 plans, entry, stop and target. Continuation exits after two completed 15m closes >0.15 signal ATR beyond frozen previous VWAP plus opposing confirmed local direction. Reversal retains V4 rule. No stop widening, new partial or time-to-progress optimization.
take-profit: Same V4 opportunities; target nearest timestamp-qualified nonproxy 15m/1h/4h/prior-day/session obstacle; reject absent objective, >6ATR, or after-cost RR<1.25. Admission-induced selection is reported separately. Same entry and initial stop.
integrated: Predetermined market-selector subset + 0.15ATR passive price + structural thesis exit + nearest qualified first objective. Combined result is confounded; no outcome-selected combination.
five_minute: Attempt genuine Gate 5m history. Only complete common window qualifies; if coverage unavailable do not manufacture bars. If qualified: register opportunities at completed 15m defended touch using preknown previous VWAP, aligned 1h structure, liquidity and signal ATR. First later completed 5m directional reclaim that closes beyond previous completed 5m high/low, expiry 60 minutes; frozen extreme/stop/objective. Compare immediate trigger and 0.15 signal ATR passive limit with 5-minute order expiry and same native 5m lifecycle; no timeframe-detail claim. A same-opportunity 15m-response on 5m execution baseline separates execution resolution. No independent-validation claim.
stress: Post-hoc extra 5/10/20 bp per side turnover sensitivity, clearly labeled; native +10bp/side and one-tick trade-through runs for control and integrated if feasible.
classification: Repeatedly inspected development; no reserved November17-December1 access; no profitability or paper readiness claim
